objective: Correct a failed change while preserving its history and retry count.

nodes.objective: Correct the parser change after the first verification found an edge case.
acceptance_criteria: The original behavior remains valid and the reported edge case passes.
verification: Run the documented parser verification and record its result.

nodes.objective: Resume the affected work after an interrupted session without losing attempts.
acceptance_criteria: The changed input is rechecked and only affected descendants are reopened.
verification: Inspect the resumed statuses and confirm prior attempt counts remain.
